chunks.text: Been thinking about doing a little food crawl in Beijing sometime soon, just to get out of my routine.
And separately, I might end up in Suzhou for a weekend and catch a show while I’m there, if the timing works out.
Also, if I’m being responsible, I’ve been considering lining up a doctor visit in Chongqing at some point—nothing urgent, just planning ahead.
If the Beijing meal thing actually happens, I was loosely imagining Imperial Kitchen for a big group—like 10 people—around 11:30 on 2026-04-18.
For that lunch, I guess it would probably be under Mia Anderson, and the date would be 2026-04-18; phone would be 13877949128 if anyone asks.
And if I do end up doing Suzhou, I’ve been eyeing Kunqu Opera Peony Pavilion—maybe First Floor seats, 4 tickets, under Noah Wilson, same 13877949128… not sure if I’ll actually do this.
